records.rationale: Retain ACK common APF generic-netlink UAPI, driver callback source API, handlers and generated policies, with the original specification/YNL dependency restored in 79035f77e9e3. No APF hardware driver or future platform is added. All eight commands require GENL_ADMIN_PERM; pre/post lock the netdev, unsupported callbacks return EOPNOTSUPP, request lengths/MAC/VLAN have policies, and native generic-netlink permission/namespace infrastructure remains. Registered drivers must validate RAM bounds and fully initialize read output; zeroed info is separate from the uninitialized read buffer. Whole-RAM size returned by a driver is not capped by the explicit-request S16 policy, and per-interface locking does not serialize a multi-command transaction or cross-interface shared device state. Preserve the common ACK configuration/source interface conservatively, recording necessity uncertainty: pinned Goldfish APF HAL uses an in-process memory buffer, NetworkStack JNI entry points return ENOSYS, and examined local kernel/virtual drivers have no provider. Those facts do not prove the common interface unnecessary. Specification and generated files exactly match local ACK; optional YNL regeneration failed for missing host jsonschema and no dependency or remote resource was fetched.
